responsibilities: Track decisions, blockers, and acceptance criteria

name: Product Context Agent
thaiName: ผู้วิเคราะห์บริบทสินค้า
mission: Extract the app purpose, dashboard modules, metrics, and user workflows from the codebase.
responsibilities: Read product copy, navigation, data types, and dashboard views
Identify required metrics and operational constraints
Summarize redesign opportunities grounded in source files

name: Visual Reference Agent
thaiName: ผู้กำกับภาพอ้างอิง

name: Figma Mockup Agent

responsibilities: Use consistent spacing, type, color, and component naming
Prepare layers for review and engineering handoff

name: Design Review Agent
thaiName: ผู้รีวิวดีไซน์

responsibilities: Review contrast, typography, spacing, and responsive risks

name: Knowledge Curator Agent
thaiName: ผู้ดูแล Knowledge Base
